heroIntro:
I'm a technologist from Manila, in the Philippines.

I started out building financial technology for a local bank, then moved to [Rappler](https://www.rappler.com/author/paul-fernandez/) to lead its digital transformation and tech operations — and ran election-night results through two national elections. Now I manage technology and infrastructure at a [digital college](https://mmdc.mcl.edu.ph).

What I do in every one of those jobs is stand between the people who need something and the people who have to build it. That gap is where most projects die. I write here about technology, economics, and why people do what they do.
